reader.requirement: At 85 a SAME AREA clause makes two or more non-sort files share all their storage areas, so the program may keep at most one of them open at a time; the compiler must accept the clause over files of any organization and access, give each file its own records when the files are used one at a time, treat the record areas of the named files as one storage area, and keep sort or merge files out of the clause (the 1985 text states no required outcome for a program that opens two at once: it is 'not valid').

edition-consulted.switches: Edition.Edition.Year < 2002 selects the 1985 report-file row (a report file may be in SAME SORT/SORT-MERGE AREA clauses); the sort-merge and other-file rows that GR1's non-sort files take are one arm at every edition
SAME and AREA are keywords by the per-edition reserved-word table; both rows are reserved at 85, 2002, 2014 and 2023

reader.edition-search: grep of FileControlBinder.IoControl.cs, FileModel.cs and the runtime IO directory for Edition, CobolVersion, DialectLevel, ConstructRegistry, SameClauseKind.Area and SameArea; Validation and Editions searched for sameClause and ioControl (no hit). The file-area format binds as a no-op plus membership at every edition.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: l1c28_same_area_mixed_org covers one clause over sequential, relative and indexed files opened one at a time; not covered are variable-length records under the clause, the shared record area seen by WRITE FROM, and the sort-file exclusion

probes.printed: FS SEQ-A / FS SEQ-B 00 / FR REL-1 / FR REL-2 00 / FI K1 IDX-1 / FI K2 IDX-2 00; EXPECT: MATCH
probes.expected: each of the sequential, relative and indexed files keeps its own records when opened in turn (SR4 and GR1)
an OCCURS DEPENDING ON record and a RECORD VARYING record in one SAME AREA clause, used in turn, read back exactly what each wrote

probes.printed: error COBOL6827: WRITE FROM FB-REC: the operand names the record area of file 'FA' (§1985:VII.4.7.3 SR1)
probes.expected: the shared area includes all storage areas of FA and FB, so FB-REC is FA's storage and WRITE FA-REC FROM FB-REC names one area twice: refused

probes.printed: error COBOL2738: SAME AREA: sort or merge file 'SF' is named in a file-area format clause, which its kind bars (ISO §2023:12.4.6.4.3 SR6 ...)
probes.expected: GR1 covers files that do not represent sort or merge files, and §1985:XI.2.5.3 SR4 bars a sort file from a SAME clause without SORT, SORT-MERGE or RECORD: refused

probes.printed: OPEN FA 00 / OPEN FB 00 / FA-REC AAAAAA FB-REC BBBBBB / FA AAAAAA 00 (identical at --std 2023, sa_both_open-002)
probes.expected: the program breaks GR1 ('not valid'); the 1985 text gives no status or diagnosis, so any outcome is the implementor's; observed: both files work independently

reader.notes: The file-area format is bound as membership plus a no-op (no physical aliasing), which GR1 permits: a valid program keeps one file open at a time, so sharing is unobservable except through the record areas, and StorageSharingFiles carries that to the WRITE/REWRITE FROM rule. Opening two members at once is not diagnosed; the 1985 text asks nothing for that case. Side observation: the sort-file refusal cites §2023:12.4.6.4.3 SR6 at --std 85, where the 1985 rule is §1985:XI.2.5.3 SR4.

refuter.evidence: Read §1985:VII.2.13.2-.4, XI.2.5.3, XI.4.4.3 SR9, XIII.2.4.3 SR2 and the record-area syntax rules of READ/WRITE/REWRITE; read FileControlBinder.IoControl.cs#ScreenSameOperands, #SameOccurrenceRule, #ScreenSameClauses, FileModel.cs#StorageSharingFiles, StorageSharing.cs#IsRecordAreaOf, StatementValidation.cs#CheckPhraseOperandIsNotRecordArea, RecordAreaRule.cs#InForce. Probes under E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/coderead-1985/out/refute-1985-221/runs: (b) sa_one_file-001 SAME AREA FOR FA (one file) -> error COBOL2738 'names only one file' (format prints file-name-1 {file-name-2}..., GR1 'two or more files'): refused as required. (b/d) sa_into_peer-001 READ FA INTO FB-REC and REWRITE FC-REC FROM FA-REC, FA FB FC (seq, seq, relative) in one SAME AREA -> COBOL6827 on both, citing §1985:VII.4.4.3 SR1 and §1985:VIII.4.6.3 SR1: the shared storage reaches READ INTO and REWRITE FROM, not only the reader's WRITE FROM; at --std 2023 (sa_into_peer-002) the same program compiles (RecordAreaRule.InForce < 2014), the right 2014+ arm. (c/e) sa_report_failopen2-001: a report file (1985-only admission, XIII.2.4.3 SR2) in SAME AREA with two sequential files; OPEN INPUT of the missing member -> 35, then FA OPEN 00, write, close, report OPEN 00 and GENERATE (file 'LINE-ONE'), FA re-read 'ABCDEFGH 00': the failed OPEN leaves no member open and the others work in turn. (c) sa_sort_using_giving-001: SAME AREA FOR FA FB with SORT SF USING FA GIVING FB, which §1985:XI.4.4.3 SR9 permits (it bars pairs only in SAME SORT/SORT-MERGE AREA; the compiler also refuses SF FA FB in one SAME SORT AREA, sa_sort_area-001 COBOL1757, as SR9 requires) -> compiles, runs, FB AAAA/BBBB/CCCC.
